description: This file defines the implementation of the DnsConfigOverrides class, including constructors, comparison operators, static creation method, and an override application method, for DNS configuration overrides in the Chromium project.

classes.name: DnsConfigOverrides
classes.description: Represents DNS configuration overrides with methods for comparison, creation, and application of overrides.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators (copy and move) for DnsConfigOverrides.

methods.name: CreateOverridingEverythingWithDefaults
methods.description: Creates an override object with all fields set to default values.

methods.name: OverridesEverything
methods.description: Checks if all override fields are set.

methods.name: ApplyOverrides
methods.description: Applies the override settings to a given DnsConfig object.
